notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one Elf on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Wellwisher's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
